## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Segovia, Spain. It starts at Calle Marqués del Arco 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> For a city of its size, Segovia has an unfair amount of ancient wonders. Nestled between the fairy-tale Alcázar de Segovia and the city's soaring Roman aqueduct, the Cathedral of Segovia is another stunning remnant of bygone times.
>
> Explore this Gothic wonder, from its underground art gallery to the grandiose cloister and cavernous central nave, all with a handy paperless ticket.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €5.75. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 76 ratings and 36 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
